summary: Elemental-birth family 8632/8633/8634/8635: prototype runs Damage then Cause*; native CauseEntangle/Burning/Frozen/Stun FromTarget precedes Damage (R001). Observable: an enemy killed by the hit never receives the status / status-apply event.

Frostling 7431: prototype targets enemyRandom but native spell Target Enemy (Cause* FromTarget) = chosen enemy; mana segment is halve (floor(manaCost/2)) but native GenerateMana StatusAmount 4 AddFor10BlueGems = fixed 4 (equal only while manaCost is 8).

Eternal Sentinel 8795: native CreateGems2Colors GoodGargoyle/BadGargoyle; prototype creates tier-less gargoyleGem (engine treats as Good) so Evil Gargoyles never appear. builders.createSpecialGems2 already documents the correct form for this spell.

Spell mana grants (buff.ts buffOne 'mana', incl. halve/fraction) ignore Silence; official status list: Silence prevents a troop from gaining any mana (ManaDistributor/enchanted already honour canGainMana).

GenerateHalfMana / GenerateQuarterMana rounding for odd mana costs: runtime floor(manaCost x ratio) (DECISIONS.md project ruling); no English/native/official source found for floor vs round vs ceil. Observable for any target whose manaCost is not divisible (Relic Knight targets any ally).
Relic Knight 8925 CreateGems Color1 Spirit has no colour; project creates Purple Spirit Gems (CLAN-GEM-SOURCE-CHECK: provisional colour, colour set unverified).
Native DecreaseMana (English 'drain') assembled as steal(..., 'mana', 'mana') so the caster refills with the drained mana: 8598, 9513, 9534, 9784, 9957. Native StealMana is a separate step type.

Native DecreaseMana with fixed Amount and no SpellPowerMultiplier assembled via reduce()/steal() default mult=1, i.e. drain [Amount + Magic]: 7265, 8598, 8654, 9051, 9067 (lane-L3/mana-audit.mjs SUSPECT-MULT).

oncePerBattle (native DisableMySpell Self) is checked as actionLog.some(entry.skillId === skillId): an enemy (or another ally) casting the same spell id disables my troop's spell. DisableMySpell targets Self, i.e. the casting troop only.

Champion of Anu 7668: prototype drainAll -> stun -> silence; native CauseStun -> CauseSilence -> DecreaseMana 100 (R001). Observable: Stun disables Mana Shield (isImmuneToManaDrain), so native order drains a Mana Shield target, prototype order does not.
DRACOS-1337 7395: prototype silence -> stun; native CauseStun -> CauseSilence (R001). Observable: Stun disables immunity traits first, so native order lands Silence on a Silence-immune troop.

Jellymaid 9816: native second Cleanse targets RandomPrefNotPrevAlly; prototype uses allyRandom twice, so the same ally can be picked twice while others are available. No ally prefer-not-previous TargetMode exists (only enemyRandomPrefNotPrev).
note: 16 other pending native RandomPrefNotPrevAlly spells still assembled without the new mode: 7666 7786 7945 8024 8390 8650 9199 8970 9528 9529 9530 9531 9641 9776 9874 weapon 7654.

summary: Native GenerateRandomMana Amount N (English '3-N Mana' to several allies): runtime rolls once per segment and gives every recipient the same value (R22 batch convention, no source). Independent per-ally rolls are equally plausible; community t/80087 only reports a min-3 bug. The implicit min 3 is consistent across all English texts.

secondary.ts modifierBonus sums all `sources` then applies one ratio floor; native has one Count* step per source, each floored (R003 per-step counter), and 8785 English says '+1 more for every 3 Green Allies and +1 more for every 3 Green Gems'. 2 allies + 2 gems -> runtime 1 bonus, native 0. Affects ~45 pending ratio multi-source prototypes (lane-L3 reverse search: 7252 7454 7470 7489 7644 ... 9882, weapon 7568); none accepted.
note: Trial primitive fix (per-source floor) reverted: accepted troop:6320 (7470, same native two-CountArmor-34 shape, L7 accepted combined floor(total x 34%)) and custom Lianka/YeLuo tests assert combined flooring. Needs a coordinator ruling on per-step vs combined counters; repro kept as it.fails.
